overview: Folium Phase IV is part of Sumadhura's Folium signature series in Whitefield, offering 3 and 4 BHK homes across Wing Oak and Wing Elm. Layouts include Classic and Smart variants with dedicated study rooms, walk-in wardrobes in select 4 BHK homes, and generous balcony areas.

Smart layouts include a dedicated study room

Located in Whitefield Village, K.R. Puram Hobli
